'''Knel'char II''' was one of the three stars that were orbited by [[Darkknell/Legends|Darkknell]], along with [[Knel'char I]] and [[Knel'char III|III]].

{{Star-stub}}

==History==
When [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Daiman]] ruled Darkknell, he made the populace believe he was always watching them through the stars Knel'char II and Knel'char III, which he referred to as his "eyes". If a person snickered when the stars' orbits made him seem cross-eyed, Daiman would send out his [[Corrector]]s to "correct" that person.
